title: security-rbac-v2-kms-region-residency-audit-hardening
author: Aisha Gomez
release_notes: Security: Enforce KMS region pinning on RBAC v2 resources with residency requirements; add detailed audit logs for KMS selection and key usage; include migration tool for existing policies; update docs and rollout plan.
description:
Summary: Enforce KMS region pinning and strengthen audit logging for RBAC v2. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require strong guarantees that keys and encryption materials are bound to a specified region and that any deviations are auditable. This PR implements enforcement in the policy evaluation layer, emits structured audit events when key resolution or fallback occurs, provides a migration tool for existing policy rules, adds unit/integration tests, and updates docs and rollout playbook.

Details: - Policy enforcement: new check 'kms_region_residency' in rbac_v2 evaluator; when a resource is annotated with residency:region, the policy engine now rejects any KMS key selection that would use a KMS key outside that region unless an explicit override role is present. - Audit logging: structured audit events emitted to the audit log sink and to the KMS-audit index with fields {resource_id, requested_region, selected_key_id, selected_key_region, evaluator_reason, principal, request_id}. Events are JSON and include trace/span IDs for correlation. - Migration tool: cli command 'rbac-migrate-kms-residency' that scans policies and resources, reports violations, and optionally patches resources to add the residency annotation or create KMS aliases in the correct region. - Backwards compatibility: default behavior is opt-in via feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' scoped per-organization. When the flag is off we still emit audit events for key choices to surface misconfigurations. - Testing: unit tests for evaluator, integration tests for key fallback behavior, e2e in staging that exercises canary rollout. - Rollout plan: enable audit-only mode in staging -> enable enforcement for a small cohort (10%) -> expand to all orgs after 7 days with no violations -> offer migration assistance for orgs with flagged violations.

Checklist: - [x] evaluator logic and policy primitives implemented - [x] structured audit events added + schema docs - [x] migration cli implemented with dry-run - [x] unit and integration tests added - [x] console UI flag and org-level feature flag wired - [x] docs updated in redwood-docs (guide + migration notes) - [x] e2e verified in staging

Notes on security review: I ran threat-modeling with SecOps and addressed a potential elevation vector where an override role could be mis-scoped. The PR includes a validation that override roles must be explicitly granted via a GroupAction with RBAC permission 'kms:override_region_pin'.

Runtime implications: minimal steady-state cost; enforcement path short-circuits before key material is requested in most cases. Telemetry counters added: kms_region_pin_violation_count, kms_region_pin_audit_event_count, kms_region_pin_enforced_count.

Related: ENG-4582, SEC-1191, SUP-4312.

review_comments: Ethan Park (reviewer): Please add a unit test covering the override role path where the override role is scoped to a child org. Also can we avoid a linear scan of KMS keys in SelectKey? It would O(n) for some customers.
Aisha Gomez (author): Added targeted unit test for override role path and refactored SelectKey to use the policy tag index to narrow candidate keys. Tests updated in commit 9f4a2b3.
Maya Patel (reviewer): Audit schema looks good; suggest adding selected_key_fallback_reason field to help SRE troubleshoot key creation fallbacks.
Aisha Gomez: Added selected_key_fallback_reason to the audit payload and updated schema docs. Also added an observability dashboard to surface frequent fallback reasons.
Rohit Singh (security): Verified that override role requires explicit permission 'kms:override_region_pin'. Recommend adding e2e to ensure RBAC deny is enforced in a cross-tenant attempt.

merge_outcome: squash and merge by Maya Patel; brief release note added; feature gated by org-level flag; rollout scheduled per playbook
notes: This PR is part of the broader RBAC v2 hardening initiative for enterprise compliance customers. Post-merge action items: monitor kms_region_pin_violation_count for flagged orgs and schedule migration runs with customer success for orgs with > 10 violations.
migration_instructions: Use tools/rbac-migrate with --dry-run to generate a report. If report is clean, run with --apply to attach residency annotations or create regional KMS aliases. See docs/security/kms-region-residency.md for details.
risk: Medium: enforcement introduces potential for lawful outages for misconfigured orgs; mitigated by feature flag, audit-only rollout, and migration tooling.
